price_rule.statement: One EasyField credit is one upstream provider credit. The catalog encodes a unit conversion, not a markup; all margin lives in the sale price of an EasyField credit (billing_private.plan_catalog).
evidence: src/data/pricing.ts formatEstimate/formatCharged render the upstream creditPrice with a "cr" suffix in the only display mode any caller uses.
Every generation screen renders res.credits (the provider-reported creditsConsumed) directly as the customer charge.
billing_private.plan_catalog credit prices reproduce the blessed 39.4%-73.3% margin band only at 1:1 against $0.005 per provider credit.
price_rule.note: The "2x margin floor" check proposed in the spec is a tautology under this rule (customer/100 and provider*2 are identically equal) and must not be described as a safety check.

source.upstream_feed: POST /client/v1/model-pricing/page (public, unauthenticated). Host is the base64 default in plugin/main.cjs.
source.inclusion_rule: A row is seeded only when the reviewed fallback in src/data/pricing.ts and the live feed give the SAME credits, the model_id is byte-identical to what the desktop client submits (or is an explicitly synthetic label for a family whose body carries no model id), the (family, create_path, poll_path) triple is one of the six legal pairs, and the unit ceiling is published in the shipped UI contract.
source.provider_cost_derivation: provider cost is derived from creditPrice * 5000, not usdPrice * 1e6. 399 of 404 feed rows agree; the five that disagree include a 10x usdPrice error on grok-imagine image-to-video 1080p and 1.85 vs 1.90 on Google veo 3.1 text-to-video Quality-4K. Every seeded row records both so the disagreement stays visible.
source.discount_rate_meaning: discountRate is a competitor comparison against falPrice, not a promotion applied to usdPrice. discountPrice is false on all 404 rows, so no seeded price has a promotion baked in.
source.credit_unit_hazards: creditUnit is not a join key: the feed contains an empty string, a double space ("per  image"), a trailing space ("per request "), and the misspellings "per milion tokens" and "per vedio".

units.image: one output image. A multi-image run fans out into one create per image (src/services/run.ts), so maximum_units is 1.
units.second: one second of rendered output. maximum_units is the published duration ceiling for that model.
units.character: one input character. The feed quotes per 1000 characters; the per-character rate is exact, and maximum_units is the shipped 5000-character input ceiling.
